# Temomi Home Massage

> 24/7 home service massage in Metro Manila, Philippines. A therapist comes to your home, condo or hotel room. 2 hours of massage from ₱999.

- Massage types: Swedish, Shiatsu, Thai, Combination, Foot Massage
- Service areas: Pasay, Parañaque, Makati, Mandaluyong, BGC, Ortigas Bungad (Metro Manila). Other areas on request.
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Price: from ₱999 for 2 hours. Final rate depends on massage type and location and is confirmed before the therapist leaves. No hidden fees.
- Booking: call, WhatsApp or Viber 0956 125 6880 (+63 956 125 6880). No app or account needed.

- [Book](https://temomimassage.services/book.html): booking form that sends to WhatsApp or Viber
